facts:
## CELL FACTS

Cell 土_正印 (Earth carrying The Sage). Persona The Sage (正印). Definition line: "Nourishment that deepens without redirecting, the root that holds". Keyword Care, charge gentle, poles catalyst Wisdom / friction Comfort. Family function: Mind. Cost dimension: the root that holds; shelter that can become stillness. Arena: roots, old trees, the deep well, inherited warmth. Classical portrait: shelter and nourishment that deepens without redirecting; over-protection, "not ready yet" as a place to stay. Ruled domains: Knowledge, Shelter, Nurture. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 偏印.
Element arena: Earth (ground, soil, load, field, bedrock, harvest). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Metal. structural_interaction seed: "Earth generating Metal cross-polarity — stability nourishing precision and opening direction".
- k2_overview: "Your Earth moves as the Sage: mother ground, nurture in its home element, doubled. You hold people the way land holds houses, unconditionally, for generations, without once mentioning the load. Wisdom settles in you and stays. The whole village builds on your patience. Somewhere in the acreage, keep a field that feeds only you."
- k2_functional: "You think in generational wisdom: what held the family, what will hold it next."
- adj_chips: {"catalyst":["Grounding","Enduring","Sustaining"],"friction":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Knowledge":"Your knowledge is settled sediment: practical wisdom layered by years, the kind villages consult. You know what actually works. Write the almanac down. Ground should not be the only copy.","Shelter":"Your shelter is the family land itself: people return to you between every attempt at the world. Being home is holy work with no clock. Post seasons. Even land lies fallow.","Nurture":"The nourishing thread is bedrock here. Where care came early, you draw on it without thinking. Where it was missing, you became the ground yourself. Keep one plot for you."}

- Sibling cell 土_偏印 friction row 0 drive passage, for the sibling test on the tension (this row must name a different either-or): "Pulling back is where you rest, long before it is any kind of reaction. Company drains a battery in you that solitude recharges, and the door drifts toward closed on its own schedule. Nothing has to go wrong first. The pulling back is the baseline."

Core element Metal, energy element Earth. Law: Earth feeds Metal (土生金: ore grows in the mountain). Relative to the core the energy is the feeder, so Earth is this core's Mind. No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Metal core that shows Earth on the friction pole, so no percentage and no state of one chart appears in any value. The friction pole of Earth as the Mind is the Overfueled band's case (the core has more than it channels); tone by pole: reminder. Rows: row 0, row 1, row 2, each with its three angles (drive, cost_self, cost_others: the drive, the cost to the reader, the cost to others; the app shows one angle per row by position rotation, so each passage must stand alone); one chip per row, written once and copied byte-identical onto the row's three fields. value.text: The safe choice is made in you before you look at the others. You carry Earth past what you need, so being held wins over being tested. Keep in mind that comfort is for resting in rather than living in, and you decide which one this is.

value_b.text: You keep what you have rather than find out what else there is. Because comfort feels like safety to you, you pick the known house over the open door and change your days slowly. Remember, you can be safe without being small, and you get to pick which word is yours.

value.text: Staying where you are held is a choice you make without noticing. Because the unknown costs you worry where the known costs you boredom, you pick the boredom rather than the worry and call it peace. Remember that you pay for that peace in chances that asked for a yes, and the bill comes slowly.

value.text: Keeping those you love out of harm is the first thing you do with any news. Because their safety feels like your job, you carry a risk for them rather than watch them take it. Remember, you build walls as well as a roof, and you decide where the door goes.

value_b.text: You step in ahead of the fall rather than after it. Needing the people close to you alright runs deeper than needing them free, so you solve what they were about to learn from. Remember that you cannot be hurt in someone's place, and you take the lesson whenever you take the fall.

value.text: Where you first learned something is also where you go back to check it. Because a handed-down answer feels safer to you than a new one, you ask the same few voices rather than a stranger. Remember that you kept the answer while the question moved, and you are the one who notices.

value_b.text: You go to the same few people for answers and get the ones you expected. Because being told what you already know feels like being held, you ask the voices that agree rather than the ones that argue. Remember that you picked those voices yourself, and you are free to pick one more.

value.text: Reaching for the answer you were handed is easier than finding a new one. Because what you were always told feels truer than what you have not tested, you stop asking once the old answer arrives. Remember that you inherited those answers rather than earned them, and you only own the ones you earned.

value.text: Your first answer to a new idea is the old one. Because a tested answer feels kinder than an open question, you hand people what you were given rather than what they asked. Remember that you send them off with your answer in place of theirs, and you deny them the one they came for.
